description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Together AI is an AI-native cloud company that provides scalable inference, model fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and pre-training services. The early-career Software Engineer will design and maintain software, build product features, optimize performance, and collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams across machine learning, platform engineering, infrastructure, and inference.
Software engineer building product features across systems and user interfaces, with ownership of development and debugging.

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain high-quality software across our tech stack from low-level system to customer-facing UIs
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver features and improvements
• Take high autonomy over your work - own projects end to end
• Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization
• Contribute ideas to shape the direction of our products and technical infrastructure
• Work on real, meaningful projects and learn from experienced professionals along the way

Requirements:
• Actively pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, earned or expected by Summer 2027
• Solid CS fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, systems thinking)
• Past hands-on experience through internships, personal projects, or previous roles
• Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and collaborative development workflows
• Ability to solve problems creatively and communicate trade-offs effectively
• Enthusiasm for learning and thriving in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

Preferred:
• Experience with web development, databases, distributed systems, or cloud platforms, OSS contributions
